messages:
Alex: Quick sync — planning coordinated version bumps across runtime, API, console, and SDKs. Proposal: bump order runtime -> api -> console -> sdks, deploy window Wed 09:00–12:00 PT. Cutoff for PRs Tue EOD. Who's owning each?
Maria: I can own console. Do we need a changelog entry per repo or a consolidated one?
Alex: Prefer per-repo short entry + one consolidated release notes doc. Keeps ownership clear.
Jiwon: Runtime bump is potentially semver-minor (perf opt) — will that require SDK changes?
Tim: SDKs should be backwards compatible; pinning runtime client to >=new-minor. If runtime adds opt-in flags, no SDK change.
Sam: I'll open PRs for SDKs once runtime tag is live. Will include compatibility matrix in PR body.
release-bot: preflight checks queued: runtime CI, api integration tests, console e2e. Expected runtime CI ETA: 25m.
devex-bot: Reminder: fill out the release checklist template: https://redwood.internal/release-checklist (use the "interrepo-bump" section)
Maria: Console PR template snippet I use:
```
- bump: patch
- changelog: short note + link to runtime tag
- rollback plan: revert console-config v2 -> v1
```
Jiwon: Two quick asks: 1) Can we run a small canary after runtime deploy against QA traffic? 2) If runtime rollback needed, what's expected API behavior?
Tim: Canary yes — 5% traffic to canary runtime variant for 30m. On rollback, API will fallback to previous runtime by tag; we've automated KV cache invalidation in that path.
Alex: Action items: runtime owner @Jiwon — cut tag + run canary. API owner @Tim — validate compatibility and prepare fallback. Console owner @Maria — prep changelog and smoke tests. SDK owner @Sam — PRs opened after runtime tag. Everyone: please add PR links to this thread when created.
Sam: noted, will ping with PR URLs.
Maria: one small ask — can we include a line in consolidated notes about latency expectations post-bump? Ops wants a green baseline.
Alex: Good point. Ops, please paste baseline latency numbers here or add to the release doc.
Tim: I'll attach metrics snapshot to the release doc once runtime CI passes.
release-bot: CI status update: runtime CI passed, api integration queued.
Alex: Thanks — I'll nudge teams Tue morning for final PRs. Ping me if anything slips past cutoff. :thumbsup:
